name: 蒙面的女骑手
src: 月银纪史诗/第四歌_雷纹豹裘.md:645
gear: 神（立誓者奥尔达行走人世，扮南原女骑手）｜—｜不打仗｜不出｜页上写祂不亲手杀人；用户 11-07 定神行走人世不出战斗服，cells 只写三套；battle 一句照写备着，不出图
who: A veiled woman rider of the southern steppe whom every clan takes for someone from another clan: about 175 cm, tall, straight-backed and long-limbed, with a rider's poise. A black gauze veil across the lower half of her face and a black hood over her hair; only a few strands of glossy blue-black hair slip out. Above the veil her eyes are startlingly bright, a pale clear gold. On the ring finger of her right hand a ring of grey stone carved with two clasped hands (on the viewer's left when they face us). Beneath the veil is a face of great beauty that no one sees. Silent, watchful, cold. The black veil covers the nose and mouth in every panel and every expression; only the eyes and brows show. No other jewellery.
build: 175 cm, tall and long-limbed: straight strong shoulders, a slim waist, long legs, a rider's balance.
palette: veil black, pale clear gold, dark felt, red-ochre lining, grey stone
casual: Her riding clothes in the steppe fashion: a long black felt riding robe split at the sides for the saddle, closing down the front with buttons, fitted sleeves, the hem and cuffs trimmed with dark fur, a dark red-ochre lining showing at the slits; black leather leggings and soft riding boots; the black hood and the black gauze veil; a short horsewhip of plaited black horsehair in her left hand. She stands watchful, the eyes bright above the veil.
private: Between the tents at night: the riding robe hanging open over a long dark wool under-dress with fitted sleeves, the hood down on the shoulders but the veil still across the lower face, the blue-black hair in one long braid down the back; a small horn cup of mare's milk in one hand. A quiet, cold look.
battle: She does not fight with her own hand: the black riding robe belted tight, the hood up and the veil fastened, riding gloves, a thin black snake coiled harmlessly round her left wrist and forearm, the right hand raised with the stone ring turned outward. A cold, steady look.
formal: As a guest at the queen's tent feast: a long black wool gown closing down the front with small silver buttons, fitted sleeves, a black fur-trimmed mantle over the shoulders, a fine black silk veil across the lower face held by a thin silver chain over the hood, the stone ring on her right hand. She stands straight and still.
art: A portrait close on the eyes, the face turned three-quarters, the pale gold eyes above the black veil looking straight at the viewer, bright and unreadable. Cold blue dusk light from one side, a thin warm line of campfire along the edge of the veil. Foreground blur: a fold of black gauze blown across the lens and the dark, maneless neck of a black horse at the edge of the frame.
